Lead origin: inbound trial sign-up (marketing form).

Use-case: customer-support assistant + doc search for help center articles. Intends to index internal KB and route to hosted API for generation and reranking. Primary concern = storing customer prompts (tickets) + attachments.

Key privacy questions (from CTO Priya Nair):
- Do you retain raw prompts or only derivative telemetry? need explicit retention windows.
- Can we opt-out of having our data used for model training? (asked: 'We need a no-training checkbox for our account')
- Is there an API to delete past prompts + responses programmatically? SLA for deletion?
- Are logs redactable/hashed at ingest? options for client-side redaction + Redwood-provided SDK?

- Audit trail: token-level metadata (user ID, route, model version) retained for how long? exportable?

Security notes / red flags:
- Handling PII in support transcripts — must show dataflow for security review.
- Region/residency: prefer NA; want confirmation logs won't leave region.
- Compliance ask: SOC2 is nice-to-have for procurement documentation.

What we provided so far:
- Pricing deck (drive link) + strawman retention SLA options (30/90/180 days).
- Redaction SDK link and code snippets; demo plan to show client-side PII hashing.
- Example API call demonstrating 'do_not_store' header and delete-job endpoint.

Quotes / snippets from calls: "If we can't guarantee opt-out for training and a short TTL, procurement won't sign." — Priya Nair, CTO.
